title: ggml-org published a GGUF distribution of Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base
summary: On 2026-08-06, the dated link recorded a GGUF distribution of Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base on Hugging Face. This was a downstream distribution step rather than an upstream Qwen model release, but it materially expanded the local-runtime deployment path for the project.
